trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to do. Follow the roadmap in this guide in order — story first, then the missable partner and choice moments, then the collectibles and grinds — and the platinum is the last trophy you will hear. Keep a manual save before the final mission and before any big story choice, so a missed moment never forces a full replay.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; confirms the platinum is awarded for earning all other 54 trophies.

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which introduces Lucia and Jason and the fishing mechanic. Follow the on-screen prompts — cast, wait for the bite, then reel in steadily without snapping the line. It is an unmissable story mission, so the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms Gone Fishing is the opening story mission and this trophy is unmissable.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1, playing the mission markers in order around Vice City and Leonida. Chapter progress is tracked in the pause menu, so you can see which missions remain. The trophy pops on the chapter-complete screen and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms Chapter 1 completes by finishing its story missions in order.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. The chapter opens up more of Leonida, so take new mission markers as they appear on the map and keep your gear stocked between jobs. Like every chapter trophy, it pops when the final mission of the chapter ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms Chapter 2 is completed through its story missions.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3, which centres on Vice City itself. Work through the mission markers in order and use the mission-replay option if you ever fail one — a failed attempt never locks you out. The trophy pops when the chapter's last mission completes.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms Chapter 3 completes by finishing its story missions.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Stock up on armour and ammo before the chapter's bigger set-pieces, and keep a save at the chapter start. The trophy pops on completing the chapter and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms Chapter 4 is completed through its story missions.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission after Chapter 4. It is a long, multi-stage finale, so bring full armour, your best weapons, and make a manual save right before you start it — if the finale offers a choice, that save is your safety net. The gold trophy pops when the credits roll.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms this gold trophy is awarded for completing the final mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when its marker appears. It is a driving-and-delivery job: stick to the route, do not dawdle, and the mission ends with the drop-off. Unmissable — it pops as soon as the mission completes.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: TrueTrophies — GTA VI trophy list; confirms Breakfast Run is a story mission trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist, one of the game's big set-piece robberies. Follow the crew's plan through the approach, the vault, and the getaway, and use cover during the escape shootout. The trophy pops when the heist mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms The Cartel Heist is a story heist mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it unlocks. It is a character-driven mission, so follow the dialogue prompts and the marker — there is no tricky objective to fail. The trophy pops on mission completion.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms Child's Play is a story mission trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners, which revolves around the Leonida music scene. Play the mission markers in order and watch for the quick-time-style prompts during the showpiece sequence. The trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: TrueTrophies — GTA VI trophy list; confirms Headliners is a story mission trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Expect a vehicle chase and an on-foot section inside the airport grounds — keep moving between cover and do not let the target vehicle get away. The trophy pops when the takedown mission completes.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; confirms VCIA Takedown is a story mission at the airport.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory, a large combat operation. Bring heavy weapons and armour, use your partner for covering fire, and clear each objective zone before pushing on. The trophy pops when the operation ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms Operation Savage Glory is a story mission trophy.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% in the in-game completion checklist: all story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and the bulk of the side content in this guide. Treat it as the last gold before the platinum — the pause-menu stats screen shows exactly which categories are incomplete, so mop those up one at a time. Almost every other trophy in this list feeds into it.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; confirms 100% completion requires story, strands, collectibles and activities.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in free roam: jumps, near misses, long airtime, drifts and two-wheel driving all count, and the stats screen tracks your total. The fastest route is the marked stunt jumps and ramps scattered around Leonida — hit one, land it, and drive straight to the next. It builds up naturally across a full playthrough, so check your count before grinding the last few dozen.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms stunts include jumps, near misses and airtime, tracked in stats.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of every activity type Leonida offers — races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, drone racing, meditation, hunting and the rest. You do not need to win or finish them well; a single attempt at each type counts. Open the activities list in the pause menu to see which types you have not tried yet, then tick them off one by one.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms one attempt at each activity type is enough.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge — there are 42 of them across the ranges in Leonida. Each challenge is repeatable, so practise a course until you know the target order, then go for a clean, fast run. Aim for headshots where the scoring rewards them, reload during lulls, and do the short-range pistol courses first to learn the timing.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms 42 Shooting Range challenges, all repeatable, gold required in each.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 race locations around Leonida. Fly one slow practice lap first to learn the gates and the tight corners, then race for the win — cutting corners between gates usually costs more time than it saves. The race markers stay on the map until you have won at each one, so work through them region by region.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms 14 Top Fun drone race locations, one win needed at each.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — replays of the same race do not count, so you need 20 distinct events. Mix street races, off-road and circuit events across Vice City, the Keys and the countryside, and match the vehicle class to the race. Each race marker shows whether you have won it, so pick un-won races until the counter hits 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: TrueTrophies — GTA VI trophy list; confirms 20 different race wins are required.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal issues the challenge during the fishing strand — accept it as soon as it is offered and fish it there and then, because a declined or abandoned challenge may not come back. Match Cal's catch by reeling steadily, keeping tension in the middle of the gauge, and switching lures if the fish stop biting.
trophies.missable_when: When Cal challenges you to fish — accept the challenge the first time it is offered and do not leave the area until it is done.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms the fishing challenge against Cal and that it is tied to his strand.

trophies.guide: Complete a full arcade game at any arcade cabinet in Leonida — find a machine in a bar or arcade, start a game, and play it through to its end screen. You do not need a high score; finishing one game is enough. The trophy pops when the game-over or completion screen appears.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: TrueTrophies — GTA VI trophy list; confirms finishing one arcade game is enough.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play through Andy's stranger strand to its final mission. Andy's missions appear as a stranger marker on the map — take each one as it unlocks and keep going until the strand's last job. The trophy pops when that final mission completes, and the strand stays available after the story, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms Andy's strand ends in a final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play through Kenton's stranger strand to its final mission, following his marker as new jobs unlock. Kenton's jobs are boat and waterfront work around the coast, so keep a fast boat handy. The trophy pops on the strand's final mission and the strand remains available after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms Kenton's strand ends in a final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play through Billy's stranger strand to its final mission, taking each job from his map marker as it appears. Billy's strand is built around riding — a good bike makes his jobs much easier. The trophy pops when the final mission completes.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: TrueTrophies — GTA VI trophy list; confirms Billy's strand ends in a final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them, so find three more stranger markers across Leonida and finish those strands too. Each strand is a chain of small missions that unlocks one at a time from its map marker. Stranger strands stay open after the story ends, so work through them in the cleanup phase and count them off in the tracker.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms 8 complete stranger strands are required.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play through Randy's stranger strand to its final mission, following his marker as jobs unlock. Randy's jobs are scattered across the state, so check the map for his marker between story missions. The trophy pops when the strand's final mission completes.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms Randy's strand ends in a final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play through Tyrone's stranger strand to its final mission, taking each job from his marker as it unlocks. Tyrone's strand leans on driving and delivery work, so keep a fast, sturdy car ready. The trophy pops on the final mission and the strand stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: TrueTrophies — GTA VI trophy list; confirms Tyrone's strand ends in a final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Spots are quiet scenic places — beaches, parks, hilltops and viewpoints — and each one shows a prompt to sit and meditate when you arrive. Work through them region by region and use the map to mark the ones you have done; the trophy pops at the last spot.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms 18 meditation spots across Leonida.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for during his strand. Bret points you at the animal and the area it roams — go there with a scoped rifle, move slowly, and take the shot only when you have a clear line, because this animal appears once and a missed or failed hunt may not be offered again. If the hunt fails, reload your last save rather than leaving the area.
trophies.missable_when: During Bret's strand, when he sends you after the unique animal — do the hunt immediately and reload a save if it fails.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms a unique animal hunt for Bret.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, bars, garages and out in the countryside — so pick up every card you pass and check the collection screen to see which sets are close to complete. Sets can be finished in any order, and duplicates can be traded or swapped where the game allows it.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms card sets are completed from cards found across Leonida.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the in-game phone's photo-sharing activity — open it at scenic spots, landmarks and viewpoints across Leonida and post from each one. The counter only counts new locations, so keep moving to fresh spots; the trophy pops at the hundredth.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; confirms WAiNK posts at 100 distinct locations.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 in-game challenges from the challenges list in the pause menu — combat, driving, flying, exploration and activity challenges all count. Most of them tick over naturally during a full playthrough; when the story is done, open the list, pick the easiest unfinished ones, and clear them in batches. The trophy pops at the fiftieth.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; confirms 50 completed challenges from the in-game list.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you in free roam, build a 4-star wanted level — cause chaos until the fourth star appears — then lose the cops together and stay out of sight until the wanted level clears. Use the countryside or the water to break line of sight, and do not split up: the trophy needs your partner with you when the heat drops. Do this before the final missions, while partner free roam is still available.
trophies.missable_when: In free roam with your partner, before the final missions — partner free-roam moments end as the story closes.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms a 4-star wanted level lost with your partner present.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without letting your wanted level drop to zero between them. Plan a route of three close shops first, hit each one quickly, and keep the cops on you while you drive to the next — losing the wanted level resets the chain. A fast getaway car parked outside each shop makes the chain far easier, and this is best done while partner free roam is still available.
trophies.missable_when: In free roam with your partner, before the final missions — needs three robberies in one continuous wanted level.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms three back-to-back shop robberies with your partner, wanted level kept throughout.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by getting into them — each new model you drive or ride counts once, and the stats screen tracks how many you have found. Variety is the trick: try cars, bikes, boats, planes, trucks and emergency vehicles wherever you see them. It builds up across the whole game, so grab every unfamiliar vehicle you pass.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: TrueTrophies — GTA VI trophy list; confirms 100 distinct vehicles discovered by driving them.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus, the slow-down aiming mode. Pick a busy fight with grouped enemies — a gang shootout or a wanted-level standoff — trigger Combat Focus, and chain headshots while time is slowed. If you run out of targets, the attempt ends, so choose a fight with at least five enemies in view.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms five takedowns inside a single Combat Focus activation.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport: get airside, take a plane, and take off from the runway without following the normal departure routine. Expect a wanted level as soon as you cross onto the airfield, so go in fast, grab a small plane, and get airborne before the cops close in.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; confirms an unscheduled plane departure from VCIA.

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks — get into one and survive the heat it brings. Rhinos appear at high wanted levels and around military areas, so the simplest route is to steal one during a 4- or 5-star rampage and stay alive in it. Keep moving and use the cannon on pursuing vehicles; the trophy pops once you have had your run in a Rhino.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms the Rhino tank encounter trophy.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all — no alarms, no spotted cameras, no guard raising the alert. Case the store first, go in quiet, move only when guards look away, and get out before the alarm window closes. If you are spotted, leave and try again later; detection only fails that attempt, not the trophy.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms a jewelry store robbery with zero detection.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault job needs a plan — a getaway vehicle parked close, a route away from the bank, and enough firepower for the escape. Do them one at a time and escape cleanly each time; the counter only counts vaults you walk away from.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: TrueTrophies — GTA VI trophy list; confirms five bank vault robberies with a successful escape each time.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Vice City and the highways — follow one until it stops, breach the rear doors, grab the cash, and break away before the escort and the cops box you in. A fast car and a planned escape route matter more than firepower here.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms an armored truck robbery with escape.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida, from Ocean Beach to the swamps and the Keys. Drive, fly and sail into every corner — the map fills in as you go, and the stats screen shows which areas you have not visited yet. Save this for the cleanup phase and sweep the remaining areas in one road trip.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms 52 areas of Leonida to explore.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Each gang runs its own racket — drug labs, chop shops, smuggling docks — and the map and street chatter point you at them. Hit one operation per gang and get out clean; the trophy pops once every gang has been hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms one illegal operation robbed for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail, and sit somewhere you can see the sea — the trophy is about the moment, so take the seat with the view rather than drinking at the bar counter. It can be done any time in free roam.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: TrueTrophies — GTA VI trophy list; confirms a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: get a car inside a dealership showroom, then drive it straight out through the glass front. Line the car up with the windows first and hit the gas — the trophy is a nod to the classic showroom smash, so the exit through the glass is the point. Any showroom with a glass front works.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; confirms smashing out of a vehicle showroom through the glass.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — go to the alley, pick up a ball, and bowl a full game. Follow-through means completing your delivery properly, so play the game out rather than quitting after a frame. The trophy pops when the game ends.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms bowling a full game at the Kolt & Associates alley.

trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal — a duo moment with your partner that blows up in-game. These moments happen during partner activities and story beats where the pair draws a crowd or goes viral on the in-game social feeds. Play partner content as it appears and watch for the scene that triggers it; do it before the story closes, while partner moments are still available.
trophies.missable_when: During partner activities before the final missions — the viral partnership moment only triggers while partner content is available.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms a partnership moment with mass appeal.

trophies.guide: Make the story choices the game puts in front of you — some dialogue and mission decisions change what happens next, and this trophy tracks a major choice being made. There is no single right answer, but choices can lock off content, so keep a manual save before any big decision and pick the path you want to live with. The trophy pops when the choice plays out.
trophies.missable_when: At a major story choice — save before the decision, because a choice can lock off content.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; confirms a major story choice trophy.

trophies.guide: Succeed on your second try at something — fail an attempt at a mission objective or challenge, then nail it on the immediate retry. The cleanest way is to pick a short, repeatable challenge, miss it once on purpose, and then complete it properly the very next time. The trophy pops on the successful second attempt.
trophies.missable_when: On a retry — fail once, then succeed on the immediate second attempt; do it on a short repeatable challenge.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: TrueTrophies — GTA VI trophy list; confirms succeeding on a second attempt.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida — an unexplained event out in the world. Strange sightings cluster at night and in out-of-the-way places: the swamps, the Keys, the desert roads. Explore at night, keep your eyes open for odd lights or encounters, and the trophy pops when you stumble into one.
trophies.missable_when: At night in remote parts of Leonida — strange events are one-off sightings, so save when you spot something odd.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; confirms a strange world event trophy.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock a pedestrian down. Drive slowly past a target on foot, swing as you pass, and keep moving. It is a silly trophy by design, so pick a quiet street and a slow car for control.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms a melee drive-by knockdown.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies — take them to a contact who cleans money and launder them in batches rather than all at once. The counter tracks laundered value, so keep laundering after every big job until it hits $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms $250,000 laundered through contacts.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, ammo, cars and upgrades all count, and the total is cumulative across every shop. It builds up naturally if you keep your gear current, and in the cleanup phase you can top it up with a vehicle purchase or a full wardrobe refresh. Check the stats screen for your running total.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.sources: TrueTrophies — GTA VI trophy list; confirms $100,000 of cumulative shop spending.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages appear on the in-game property market as you progress — buy each one as it becomes available, since they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect. You will need a healthy bank balance, so do this late in the game after the big heist payouts.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide; confirms 8 garage properties to purchase.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your phone, point it at a vehicle, and register it — each distinct vehicle counts once. Walk a car park or a busy street and register ten different models; the trophy pops at the tenth.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list; confirms 10 vehicles registered in the Scooter Bros app.
